scope: Real DHCP router/DNS option delivery, DNS resolution and renewal cleanup on the isolated direct link

observations.bound: Real DHCPACK delivered 10.77.10.10/24, router 10.77.10.1 and DNS 10.77.10.1; the RAM image installed a metric-100 default route and resolver.
observations.dns: BusyBox nslookup on the panel resolved probe.touch10-validation.test through 10.77.10.1 to 10.77.10.1.
observations.renew: After the host service returned to no-router/no-DNS mode, SIGUSR1 renewal kept 10.77.10.10/24 and independent rescue 10.77.10.11/24 but removed the default route and resolver file.
observations.health: Both CPUs online; eMMC read-only; Qt started once and watchdog remained feeding. No display cycle or Qt restart requested.
observations.recovery: Requested reboot restored stock Linux/Phoenix, exact factory p8 and approved ADC sensing state in 36.7 seconds.
observations.host_cleanup: Original dnsmasq unit/config restored; no temporary override or rollback timer remained.

limits: Fixed isolated /24 lease only; arbitrary production DHCP networks and routing remain unqualified.
DNS resolution was a local .test record; upstream Internet DNS was intentionally unavailable.
No physical display/touch observation requested in this network regression.
